CSS Table Borders

The CSS
border property is used to specify
the width, style, and color of table borders.

The
border property is a shorthand property for:

items: border-width - sets the width of the border
border-style - sets the style of the border (required)
border-color - sets the color of the border

Why Double Borders?
Notice that the tables in the examples above have double borders. This is
because both the <table>, <th>, and <td> elements have separate borders.
To remove double borders, take a look at the example below.
CSS Collapse Table Borders

The CSS border-collapse property
sets whether table borders should collapse into a single border or be separated
as in standard HTML.
This property can have one of the following values:

items:
separate - Default value. Borders are
  separated; each cell will display its own borders

collapse - Borders are collapsed into a
  single border when possible
